text: If N=128 and N=256 runs of seeds 24-25 are compared at matched val_mse_ratio (about 0.18, reached at step 4000 here) instead of matched training step, is the trained force R2 gap still >= 0.04? That would tell us whether the N=256 shortfall is a convergence lag or a real difference in force decodability at equal prediction quality.
